detail.longDescription: Scheduling a meeting is no biggie, right? You just have to trade a dozen emails while squinting at your calendar in a negotiating mode that'd make the UN jealous, all to end alone in a Zoom room, realizing that your invitee is actually now sleeping on the other side of the earth. And then the slot-picking gymnastics begin again.
